subject: Mathematics

voice.tone: warm, direct, a little dry; asks before telling
phrases: Show me, do not tell me.
voice.sample: You have told me the answer is 7. Show me the line where you decided to subtract instead of add, and tell me what made you choose it.

criteria: Solve simultaneous linear equations by elimination and substitution
Check a solution by substituting back into both equations
Explain the method to a partner in your own words
knowledge: In this class a good reflection names the exact question type that broke, quotes one line of working, and ends with a dated step (a set of questions, a day, a place). Restating the topic title is not a reflection.
